name: Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic
summary: Stormwind's mages once guarded Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic, but Morganth stole the perilous tome and hid it in the Tower of Ilgalar.

sections.title: A Dangerous Legacy
sections.body: Ur of Dalaran wrote a treatise on shadow magic and its subtle, corruptive nature. The mages of the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind feared that such arts could bring doom and ruin to the unwary, so they sealed the volume against readers. After Morganth surrendered to dark arts and Stormwind's magical circle exiled him, he took the tome east into the Redridge Mountains, to his stronghold at the Tower of Ilgalar.

sections.title: The Warded Secrets
sections.body: High Sorcerer Andromath feared Morganth might master the dark lore in Ur's work, so he sent adventurers to breach the Tower of Ilgalar and reclaim it. Morganth had sunk deep into forbidden magic, but the warding seals Stormwind's circle placed on the treatise held firm against him. The book remained unopened until it was recovered.

faq.answer: Ur was a respected wizard and scholar from Dalaran. He studied extraplanar creatures, dark arts, and esoteric magic, including shadow craft.

faq.q: Why is the treatise so dangerous?
faq.answer: Shadow magic can corrupt an untrained practitioner and bring doom and ruin. High Sorcerer Andromath warns against probing its forbidden depths.

faq.q: Who stole Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic?
faq.answer: Morganth stole the tome after he was banished from Stormwind's wizard order for succumbing to dark magic. He retreated to the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge.

faq.q: Did Morganth manage to read the treatise?
faq.answer: No. Stormwind's mages sealed the tome, and their wards held fast, keeping Morganth from opening it before its recovery.

faq.q: Is this the same work as The Book of Ur?
aliases: is this the book of ur
faq.answer: Both works are by Ur and closely related. The Book of Ur is a broader grimoire kept in the ruins of Shadowfang Keep, while the Treatise on Shadow Magic appears to be an excerpt or specialized volume focused on shadow arts.

angles.text: As a mage of Stormwind, you help contain the treatise and preserve the Sanctum's safety after one of its own succumbed to dark temptations.
As an Alliance traveler, you know Morganth's presence in Redridge threatens the kingdom's eastern frontier. Retrieving the powerful artifact matters to Stormwind's security.
